meaning: The stars around the Solar System as a sky: one in 16 of the Gaia census within 100 pc, adding the stars the levels around it do not draw.
colourTowardWhiteBasis: Presentation choice: each catalogue colour mixed halfway to white before the gamma, because the saturated colours read as neon over the backing. The hue order of every catalogue is kept.
colourGammaBasis: Presentation choice, picked from three renders over the backing (full opacity, 65% opacity, gamma 1.6): each colour channel raised to the power 1.6, so the coloured dots sink into the painted arms and the whitest keep their sparkle.
